comments.author: Wolf_Vantage
comments.body_html:
Wonderful QoL change that should be in the game by default.

WARNING EDIT: This mod causes overloading mags (one going over capacity when unloading another) and that bug often gets you stuck on the inventory screen, effectively finishing your run without using tricks like teleporting your character to extraction points or ending the raid in success via Escape menu (SVM option).

comments.author: Wolf_Vantage
comments.body_html: Indeed. I was troubleshooting mods lately because that has ruined some of my raids and this comment helped me find out what’s causing it. Thanks!
